column1: # Ledger of the differences between the names the derived per-standard IEEE
# package sources declare and the names fsim's projected packages give
# (standard, package, side, names, class, finding).  fsim.ieee-name-agreement
# requires exactly these rows.  Classes: "fsim projection bug" (P1-P8 of the
# bbv round 2 report, with the clause) and "derivation limitation" (the text
# cannot contain the name).  Sides: derived-only = the derived text declares
# the names and fsim's projection (standard_package_declarations plus the
# unit's own declarations) lacks them; fsim-only = the reverse;
